steps.title: Observe and decide
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

# First cell: observe and yield to see the current state
p.observe()
print("Observation taken. Awaiting image to locate the toilet.")
steps.stdout: Observation taken. Awaiting image to locate the toilet.
